title: Wacky app, not integrated
body: Not satisfied, couldn’t end the trial-period and it’s not helpfull for me; another app which works in isolation. Would not recommend.
author: Marcfromehv

title: Eye opener
body: Sometimes, facing our mistakes requires courageous action, like deleting an app that has proven to be a disappointment, even if you paid for it.                                                                   It’s a tough pill to swallow, acknowledging that I made a poor choice. However, this experience has awakened me to the importance of thorough research before investing in anything. I’ve learned that not all shiny apps deliver value, and sometimes, letting go is the best decision. Thank you, developers, for this lesson in discernment. While it stings to part with my money, it’s a reminder to approach future purchases with more caution and wisdom.
author: Gompie K.u.t
